# Legacyskool

> Multi-tenant school management platform with portals for admins, teachers, students and parents — classes, attendance, exams (CBT), results, fees, library and AI tutoring.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview and live demo of the four portals.
- [Sign in](/signin): Sign in to your school account.
- [Register your school](/register): Create a new school workspace on Legacyskool.
